Our Services

Professional Cleaning for Every Space

Tap What's Included? to explore each service. Every cleaning is customized to the condition of the property and your needs.

🏠

Residential Cleaning

Thorough cleaning for houses, townhomes and condos.

What’s Included? +
  • Dust reachable surfaces and furniture
  • Clean kitchen countertops, sink and appliance exteriors
  • Clean and sanitize bathrooms
  • Vacuum carpets and rugs; mop accessible hard floors
  • Make beds if requested; empty small trash bins
Special requests are confirmed before service.
🧽

Deep Cleaning

More detailed cleaning for built-up dust, grease and neglected spaces.

What’s Included? +
  • All applicable routine-cleaning tasks
  • Extra scrubbing of bathroom tile, fixtures and shower areas
  • More detailed attention to baseboards, doors, frames and reachable trim
  • Clean accessible vents, light switches and cabinet exteriors
  • Detailed kitchen degreasing around stove and backsplash
  • Detailed dusting of reachable corners and surfaces
Inside oven, refrigerator, cabinets and interior windows available by request or separate quote.
✨

Routine Cleaning

Consistent upkeep with weekly, biweekly or monthly visits.

What’s Included? +
  • Dust accessible furniture, shelves and surfaces
  • Wipe kitchen counters, sink and appliance exteriors
  • Clean toilets, sinks, mirrors and showers/tubs
  • Vacuum and mop accessible floors
  • Empty small trash bins and general tidying of surfaces
Designed for regularly maintained homes; heavy buildup may need deep cleaning first.
📦

Move-Out / Move-In

Help your vacant property feel ready for the next chapter.

What’s Included? +
  • Kitchen and bathroom deep cleaning
  • Clean interior of empty cabinets and drawers
  • Wipe closets, shelves, doors and baseboards
  • Clean inside empty refrigerator and oven when quoted
  • Wipe reachable surfaces, switches and fixtures
  • Vacuum and mop floors throughout the vacant property
Property must be empty and utilities active. Wall washing, carpet shampoo, junk removal and exterior windows are not automatically included.
🏗️

Post-Construction

Fine dust and finishing cleanup after remodeling or construction.

What’s Included? +
  • Remove fine construction dust from reachable surfaces
  • Wipe shelves, counters, cabinet interiors and exteriors when empty
  • Detailed cleaning of trim, doors, frames and fixtures
  • Clean bathroom and kitchen surfaces
  • Vacuum and damp-mop finished floors as suitable
  • Spot-clean accessible interior glass where safe
Construction debris disposal, hazardous materials, high-access work and paint/cement removal require separate assessment and may be excluded.
🏢

Offices & Commercial

A clean, welcoming workplace for your team and visitors.

What’s Included? +
  • Dust common surfaces and reachable furniture
  • Clean entryways, reception areas and breakroom surfaces
  • Clean and sanitize restrooms
  • Empty designated waste bins
  • Vacuum and mop floors in agreed areas
  • Optional recurring schedule tailored to your business
Medical-grade cleaning and specialized equipment are not included.
